text_en: The words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin,
text_cn: 本雅明地内阿纳托特城的司祭中，希耳克雅的儿子耶肋米亚的言行录。──

text_en: to whom the word of the Lord came in the days of King Josiah son of Amon of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
text_cn: 上主的话传给他，是在阿孟的儿子约史雅为犹大王执政第十三年；

text_en: It came also in the days of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah, and until the end of the eleventh year of King Zedekiah son of Josiah of Judah, until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
text_cn: 以后传给他，是在约史雅的儿子约雅金为犹大王，直到约史雅的儿子漆德克雅为犹大王第十一年年底，即直到是年五月，耶路撒冷居民被掳去充军时为止。

text_en: Now the word of the Lord came to me saying,
“Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I consecrated you; I appointed you a prophet to the nations. ”
text_cn: “我还没有在母腹内形成你以前，我已认识了你；在你还没有出离母胎以前，我已祝圣了你，选定了你作万民的先知。”

text_en: Then I said, “Ah, Lord God ! Truly I do not know how to speak, for I am only a boy. ”
text_cn: 我回答说：“哎呀！我主上主！你看，我还太年轻，不会说话。”

text_en: But the Lord said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am only a boy’; for you shall go to all to whom I send you, and you shall speak whatever I command you.
text_cn: 上主对我说：“你别说：我太年轻，因为我派你到那里去，你就应到那里去；我命你说什么，你就应说什么。

text_en: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord . ”
text_cn: 你不要害怕他们，因为有我与你同在，保护你──上主的断语。”

text_en: Then the Lord put out his hand and touched my mouth; and the Lord said to me, “Now I have put my words in your mouth.
text_cn: 此后，上主伸出手来，触摸我的口，对我说：“看，我将我的话放在你口中；

text_en: See, today I appoint you over nations and over kingdoms, to pluck up and to pull down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant. ”
text_cn: 看，我今天委派你对万民和列国，执行拔除、破坏、毁灭、推翻、建设和栽培的任务。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see? ” And I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree. ”
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：“耶肋米亚！你看见什么？”我回答说：“我看见一根杏树枝。”

text_en: Then the Lord said to me, “You have seen well, for I am watching over my word to perform it. ”
text_cn: 上主对我说：“你看的对，因为我要警醒，看我的话怎样实现。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see? ” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, tilted away from the north. ”
text_cn: 上主的话二次传给我说：“你看见什么？”我回答说：“我看见一个沸腾的锅，它的口由北面倾倒过来。”

text_en: Then the Lord said to me: Out of the north disaster shall break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
text_cn: 上主对我说：“灾祸将由北方烧起，一直烧到这地上的一切居民。

text_en: For now I am calling all the tribes of the kingdoms of the north, says the Lord ; and they shall come and all of them shall set their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, against all its surrounding walls and against all the cities of Judah.
text_cn: 看啊，我必召集北方的一切国家──上主的断语──叫各国前来，在耶路撒冷城门口，在城墙四周以及犹大各城市旁，建立自己的宝座。

text_en: And I will utter my judgments against them, for all their wickedness in forsaking me; they have made offerings to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.
text_cn: 我要向各城市的人民宣告我的判决，惩罚他们的一切罪恶，因为他们离弃我，向别的神祇（qí）献香，崇拜了他们手制的作品。

text_en: But you, gird up your loins; stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not break down before them, or I will break you before them.
text_cn: 至于你，你要束上腰，起来向他们传示我命令你的一切。在他们面前，你不要畏惧，免得我在他们面前令你畏惧。

text_en: And I for my part have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and a bronze wall, against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its princes, its priests, and the people of the land.
text_cn: 看啊，我今天使你成为坚城、铜墙、铁壁，以对抗犹大君王和首领，司祭和当地的人民。

text_en: They will fight against you; but they shall not prevail against you, for I am with you, says the Lord , to deliver you.
text_cn: 他们要攻击你，却不能得胜你，因为有我与你同在，协助你──上主的断语。”
